lines.zh: 我贴着树冠飞，翅膀很响。
lines.en: I fly along the canopy, wings loud.

lines.zh: 我在空中左右摆，找目标。
lines.en: I weave in the air, looking for a target.

lines.zh: 我掠过草尖，露水全被打落。
lines.en: I skim the grass tips and knock the dew off.

lines.zh: 我悬停了一下，又往前飞。
lines.en: I hover, then fly on.
I circle the trunk once.

lines.zh: 我飞得很低，草尖都在晃。
lines.en: I fly low; the grass tips sway.
My wings beat quickly.
I rise a little to see the ground.
I dive at an angle and pull up.
I fly along the stream, looking for hives.
I sweep past a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 我飞过你的头顶，又回来。
lines.en: I pass over your head and come back.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，风推了我一下。
lines.en: I change direction; the wind nudges me.
I fly along the cliff, steady.

lines.zh: 我又绕了一圈，越飞越近。
lines.en: Another circle brings me nearer.
I stop; my wings keep beating.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膀嗡嗡响。
lines.en: I hover, wings humming.
My sting points down.

lines.zh: 我在看一片叶子的背面。
lines.en: I am looking at the underside of a leaf.
I turn my head slowly; my eyes are bright.
I hold still; only my wings tremble.
My legs are tucked under my abdomen.
I am listening inside the bark.

lines.zh: 我落在叶子上，压弯了它。
lines.en: I land on a leaf and bend it.
My abdomen pulses.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，声音变了。
lines.en: I shake my wings; the pitch changes.

lines.zh: 我停了一会儿，又飞起来。
lines.en: I rest a while, then lift off.
I stare in one direction.
I hover in front of you, very close.

lines.zh: 你的手掌能盖住三只我。
lines.en: Your palm could cover three of me.

lines.zh: 我悬在你耳后，你没听见。
lines.en: I hang behind your ear, unheard.
My sting lifts a little.
You raise a hand; I rise.
One move from you and my wings rasp.
I sweep past your shoulder.
I pause above your head.
My wingbeat sharpens.
I back off and let you move first.
I fly off crookedly.
My wings break rhythm.

lines.zh: 我歪着飞，撞了好几片叶子。
lines.en: I fly askew, hitting leaf after leaf.
I land on a leaf and tremble.
My humming drops in pitch.
One wing beats half a beat short.

lines.zh: 我撞进叶丛，停了一会儿。
lines.en: I crash into the leaves and rest a moment.
I lift off again, slower.
I circle you without closing.
My sting is still there.
This sweetness does not suit me.

lines.zh: 我用前足试了试它的重量。
lines.en: I test its weight with my forelegs.
I touch it and pull back.
Not sweet enough for me.

lines.zh: 我用口器碰了碰那滴甜。
lines.en: I touch that drop of sweetness with my mouthparts.
I try to lift it. Too heavy.
I fly toward your hand.
I settle beside your finger.
I do not take it.
I lift off and circle once.
You hit me; I fly far off.
My wings miss a beat.
I come back and hover higher.

lines.zh: 我被碰到，掉了一点高度。
lines.en: The knock costs me some height.
I hit your shoulder and recoil.
My sting grazes your sleeve.
I steady and circle again.
I am not provoked in the least.
I move to your other side.
My humming grows louder.
Another comes out of the hollow.
We fly side by side, wings in time.
We circle a branch together.
I touch it with a wingtip.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝蜂巢的方向飞。
lines.en: We fly toward the hive together.
Its sting is shorter than mine.
We land on the same leaf.

lines.zh: 我们一起嗡嗡响了很久。
lines.en: We hum together for a long time.
It leaves; I follow.
We part in the tree shade.
I clamp it with six legs.
I try to lift it. Too heavy.
I drop it at the base of the tree.

lines.zh: 我用上颚啃下一点碎屑。
lines.en: I gnaw off a few crumbs with my mandibles.
I cannot fly high carrying it.
I set it down again.
I fly a circle around it.
This cannot be carried.
I roll it down the slope.
Clutching it, I barely get airborne.
My head turns to you; my wings never stop.
My wingbeat changes.
I fix on that patch of your neck.
I am finding the right distance.
My sting is forward.
I neither close nor leave.
I remember where you are standing.

lines.zh: 我绕到你上方的树影里。
lines.en: I slip into the shade above you.
I beat my wings harder.
You give ground; I take it.
I have found an angle.

lines.zh: 我的翅一收，就要扎下去。
lines.en: My wings tuck; the sting comes down.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: I circle you, each loop tighter.

lines.zh: 我偏半尺，避开你的视线。
lines.en: I shift half a foot out of your sight.
I hover between two branches.
My sting stays aimed at you.
I will not come down to the ground.
Your arrows cannot reach me.
I close in by fits and starts.
You turn; I turn.
I wait for you to turn your back.
Your breathing is fast.
I circle low around your hat.
I have come around behind you.
I dive, sting first.

lines.zh: 我撞在你肩上，立刻退开。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and pull away at once.
My sting opens a cut.
I skim past your hand.
That one does not land.

lines.zh: 我扎进你的袖口，又拔出。
lines.en: I stab into your cuff and pull free.
I circle and charge again.
You swing; I rise clear.
I hover in front of you again.
I strike and leave without landing.
I fly out of a hollow.

lines.zh: 我先绕了一圈，看清四周。
lines.en: I circle once to see the area.
My wings sound for the first time.
There are plenty of trees here.
I fly toward where the flowers are.
I hover beside a branch.

lines.zh: 我停在枝头，翅膀还在颤。
lines.en: I settle on a twig, wings still quivering.
I lift off from the rim of the hive.
I am looking for a hive.
I start to descend.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，我掉下去。
lines.en: Fire catches my wings; I drop.

lines.zh: 半空中翅膀打结，我摔进落叶里。
lines.en: My wings tangled midair and I dropped into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 水一盖上来，我就挣不动。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I cannot fight it.
The blast pins me against the trunk.
An arrow buries itself in the bark beside me.
That light scrambles my eyes.
Too hungry to fly steady.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我掉了下来。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I fall.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有气流，我掉进去。
lines.en: No air currents in the dark; I fall in.
